Strategy: Weaken the sweet-band reward to ten while keeping the mid penalty at thirty, testing whether a gentle pull toward residuals between thirty and forty-five plus a firm penalty suffices. This keeps most Best Fit behavior intact, but the weak reward may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (10 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (30 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
